_meta.for: create-evidence-case same-technique check / memory /answer-vs-/clarify: do grounded entities converge on one answerable request, or span unrelated domains?

convergence.instructions: state.question is the user request. state.grounded is the list of controls/entities that resolved (id, name, framework) plus any known crosswalk links between them. Every entity is real and edges may exist pairwise. Judge ONLY whether these grounded entities converge on a single coherent, answerable request, or whether they span unrelated domains so the request cannot be answered as posed. Existing crosswalk edges do NOT make a request answerable if the entities address unrelated techniques.

criteria.converges_answerable: The grounded entities cluster on one shared technique/scope; the request is coherent and can be answered from them.
criteria.spans_unrelated_clarify: The grounded entities address unrelated domains/techniques with no shared bridge; the request should be clarified or split, not answered.
criteria.partial_coverage_gap: Some entities converge but a load-bearing part of the request is ungrounded; needs research or clarification before answering.
criteria.insufficient_evidence: Too few grounded entities, ambiguous references, or a compound request prevents a reliable convergence judgment.
